title: Improve visible precipitation with bounded reusable particle geometry
acceptance: Research current 160 line segments and compare bounded sprites, billboards and native particle systems before implementation; cite primary runtime sources.
Distinct soft snowflakes, compact hail, rain and drizzle with meteorological wind and no temperature-only classification; retain real source versus DEMO distinction.

Reuse bounded buffers/materials without per-frame allocation or mesh creation; avoid screen-long wrapping streaks, maintain depth occlusion, own cleanup and portable WebGL2/WebGPU shader/material support.
Expose a small controller API for root-owned Game integration; no invented accumulation, stationary indoor rain or new sensor claims.
verification: CPU geometry/classification/lifecycle tests and TypeScript; root serializes actual GPU comparison and Game integration.
notes: Direct delegation from latest expanded weather request; no recursive BMAD or GPU/server/fullsuite. Existing weather-particles helper remains root-owned read-only.
